rows.note: This is the all-purpose geographical term for a lowland area.

example.english: The scenery in that lowland area is beautiful.
example.traditional: 嗰片低地一帶嘅風景好靚。
example.jyutping: go2 pin3 dai1 dei6 jat1 daai3 ge3 fung1 ging2 hou2 leng3

rows.note: Use this for a low-lying area, especially when its low elevation creates flooding or drainage concerns.

example.english: This lowland area floods whenever it rains heavily.
example.traditional: 呢片低窪地區一落大雨就水浸。
example.jyutping: ne1 pin3 dai1 waa1 dei6 keoi1 jat1 lok6 daai6 jyu5 zau6 seoi2 zam3
